conversation.text:
Police: It’s okay. Let me ask again—was there anything different from usual in Xiyuan’s schedule today?
Respondent: No... it was the same as usual.
Respondent: She goes to kindergarten from Monday to Friday. On weekends, she usually goes to the amusement park with her family.
Respondent: There are two amusement parks inside the residential complex. She takes turns going to play at them.
Respondent: Sometimes I go with them as well. If it’s an amusement park that’s inconvenient for a wheelchair, I let Huijing take the children there by herself...
Respondent: I remember now.
Respondent: Recently, they seemed to have been going to the same amusement park. Huijing said they were going to that one today as well... The children insisted on going there to play...
Respondent: If they had gone to a different amusement park, maybe this wouldn’t have happened.
Respondent: On the way back from the amusement park, sometimes they would stop by the stationery store in front of the residential complex.
Respondent: That stationery store is called Apollo.
Respondent: Xiyuan really likes the candy there.
